issues.title: Initialize Bun workspace and shared tooling
issues.body:
Create the root package.json with workspaces and orchestration scripts, tsconfig.base.json, ESLint flat config, Prettier, EditorConfig, and .vscode settings/extensions. See handbook/01-monorepo-setup.md.

Exit: `bun install && bun run lint` is clean.

issues.title: Wire Husky + commitlint + lint-staged
issues.body: Add pre-commit (lint-staged) and commit-msg (commitlint, config-conventional) hooks so formatting and Conventional Commits are enforced locally. See handbook/01 and handbook/11.

issues.title: Scaffold the Tailwind plugin package
issues.body: Create packages/project-name with package.json (peerDep tailwindcss, three export entries), tsconfig.json + tsconfig.build.json. See handbook/02-plugin-package.md.

issues.title: Author design tokens and @property registrations
issues.body: Author src/base/tokens.css (@theme) and src/base/properties.css. Include the shape scale (--rounded-field, etc.). See handbook/02 sections 3.1-3.2.

issues.title: Build the CSS->data compile pipeline
issues.body: Implement functions/build.ts and pure extraction helpers that compile src/** into generated/*.ts, plus unit tests per helper. See handbook/02 section 4.

issues.title: Generate the default theme via Material Color Utilities
issues.body: Add functions/generate-theme.ts producing role colors from a seed. Emit the default theme at :where(:root). Always ship default. See handbook/02 section 5.

issues.title: Author component CSS for the initial set
issues.body: Button, card, input, checkbox, badge in src/components/*.css inside @layer components. See handbook/02 section 3.3.

issues.title: Implement layered border-radius for buttons
issues.body: border-radius: var(--rounded-button, var(--rounded-field)); inline utilities (rounded-full) override both. Add an E2E test asserting the fallback chain and that inline utilities win. See handbook/00 section 5 and handbook/02 section 3.3.

issues.title: Plugin options: prefix, include, exclude, themes, shape overrides
issues.body: Honor options in index.ts with validation (unknown theme/token throws). Tests for each. See handbook/02 section 6.

issues.title: Svelte library: cn, Button, ripple action, styles.css
issues.body: Scaffold packages/svelte, implement cn (clsx + tailwind-merge), Button.svelte mapping props to plugin classes, ripple action, safelist styles.css, curated barrel. See handbook/03.

issues.title: Shared prop->class contract fixture + Svelte contract test
issues.body: Author one JSON fixture (variant/role -> expected classes) at repo root and a Svelte test asserting parity. React/Vue reuse it. See handbook/04 section 8.

issues.title: React library at parity
issues.body: Scaffold packages/react (tsup, "use client"), cn, Button.tsx, useRipple, safelist styles.css, barrel. Contract test green. See handbook/04.

issues.title: Vue library at parity
issues.body: Scaffold packages/vue (Vite lib mode, vue-tsc), cn, Button.vue, ripple directive, optional app.use(), safelist styles.css, barrel. Contract test green. See handbook/05.

issues.title: Docs site scaffold with source aliasing and plugin live-reload
issues.body: SvelteKit app depending on workspace packages, vite aliases to source, pluginLiveReload plugin. See handbook/06 sections 1-4.

issues.title: Per-component reference pages with live demos
issues.body: Installation, usage, and [component] routes; Shiki code blocks with copy; light/dark toggle. See handbook/06 section 5.

issues.title: Live theme generator producing copyable CSS
issues.body: Generator page that turns a seed color into copyable theme CSS with a live preview, reusing the plugin's palette function. See handbook/06 section 6.

issues.title: CI matrix: lint, typecheck, unit, e2e, build, publint
issues.body: ci.yml running on every PR across the workspace. See handbook/08 section 2.

issues.title: Changesets release workflow to npm with provenance
issues.body: release.yml using changesets/action; version PR then publish; NPM_CONFIG_PROVENANCE. Lockstep versioning. See handbook/08 section 3 and handbook/11.

issues.title: Docs deploy: Cloudflare Workers and GitHub Pages
issues.body: docs-cloudflare.yml and docs-pages.yml. Adapter chosen via DOCS_TARGET. See handbook/08 sections 4-5.

issues.title: Repository artifacts: templates, CODEOWNERS, Dependabot, SECURITY
issues.body: Issue forms, PR template, CODEOWNERS, dependabot.yml, SECURITY.md, CONTRIBUTING.md, FUNDING. See handbook/09.

issues.title: AI agent scaffolding for Claude, Copilot, and Cursor
issues.body: AGENTS.md, .github/copilot-instructions.md, .cursor/rules, CLAUDE.md, and shared skills (add-component, verify-plugin). See handbook/10.

issues.title: Accessibility audit for 1.0
issues.body: Keyboard navigation, ARIA roles/states, focus visibility, and color contrast across all components. See handbook/07 M7.

issues.title: API review and freeze; migration notes
issues.body: Review the public API of all four packages, document it, and write migration notes for any pre-1.0 breaking changes.
